name: Fleks Workforce Management
description:
Fleks is a workforce management platform that helps organizations manage employee scheduling, shift planning, recruitment, time tracking, workforce operations, and client requests from a single system.

With the Fleks MCP connector, Claude can securely access and interact with operational data in Fleks. Users can retrieve workforce insights, analyze staffing levels, review employee availability, monitor certifications, manage recruitment pipelines, track worked hours, and automate operational workflows.

Common use cases include:

• Finding available employees for open shifts
• Filling understaffed services and projects
• Monitoring workforce utilization and performance
• Tracking attendance, hours, certifications, and compliance
• Managing recruitment and candidate pipelines
• Reviewing operational KPIs and workforce analytics
• Creating and updating shifts, assignments, and requests

The connector supports both read and write operations, allowing Claude to answer questions, generate insights, and execute operational actions directly within Fleks.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fleks Workforce Management to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fleks Workforce Management to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.fleks.works/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fleks Workforce Management MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fleks Workforce Management lists 52 MCP tools, including fleks_add_employee_field_of_interest, fleks_apply_shifts, fleks_approve_shifts, fleks_archive_jobs, fleks_bulk_create_clients, fleks_bulk_create_projects, fleks_cancel_shifts, fleks_create_clients, fleks_create_contracts, fleks_create_employee_contracts, fleks_create_employees, and fleks_create_employees_dashboard.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fleks Workforce Management?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fleks Workforce Management in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Fleks Workforce Management MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fleks Workforce Management requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fleks Workforce Management is developed by Fleks. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
